notes: White-to-red/crimson cultivar/bud-sport series; anthocyanin deployment increases with redder state. Mechanistic axis coding remains conservative where harmonized module scores are not yet frozen.
Red and pink petal sectors occur within one cultivar; anthocyanin-related transcription differs within the same genetic background.
Red sectors have more cyanidin; white sectors show lower CHS and higher ANR. P axis direction is coded as lower diversion in the red target.
Developmental pink-to-white fading with lower CrANS, reduced cyanidin and redirection toward procyanidins.
Pink flowers accumulate anthocyanin with higher downstream anthocyanin deployment; FLS is higher in white flowers.
Red > pink > white anthocyanin accumulation and anthocyanin-biosynthesis programme; retained as one independence unit, not multiple pairwise replicates.
Developmental yellow-pigment accumulation involves flavonol glycosides and carotenoids; visible yellow is not treated as a single biochemical state.
